title: Regime-timeline blocking gates (carry_decay_v1 + abstention/occupancy/upside)
summary: RATIFIED set of BLOCKING timeline gates for the open_macro_v03 regime candidate. Ratified by the quant_owner on 2026-07-11 with the bounds EXACTLY as proposed (no bound was tuned between proposal and ratification). From this decision_date the harness judges every run against these gates as a distinct blocking 'timeline' go/no_go in the gate report. The current frozen v1 model FAILS these gates on the certified 2021-2026 timeline (fresh_valid_36m 0.194, abstention streak 18, carry age 18, same-quadrant run 38): that no_go is the intended, honest outcome and stands until a recalibrated candidate passes review.

gate_semantics.min_fresh_valid_rate_36m: At least this fraction of the trailing 36 calendar months must carry a FRESH-VALID decision (a real, non-carried consumable decision). Judged on regime_timeline_metrics.fresh_valid_rate.rolling_36m. Bounds the model's tendency to abstain for multi-year stretches.
gate_semantics.max_abstention_streak_months: The longest run of consecutive calendar months without a fresh valid decision must not exceed this. Judged on regime_timeline_metrics.max_abstention_streak_months.
gate_semantics.max_carry_age_months: The greatest calendar-month distance a carried position reaches from its last valid seed must not exceed this. This is the SAME bound the carry_decay_v1 runtime cap enforces (MAX_CARRY_MONTHS = 3): past age 3 the consumable degrades to the mandate-tilted CENTER book (carry_expired). Judged on regime_timeline_metrics.max_carry_age_months.
gate_semantics.max_same_quadrant_run_months: The longest run of calendar months in the SAME consumable quadrant over the carry-filled latched chain must not exceed this. Directly bounds the 2023-02 -> 2026 contraction anchor the audit flagged. Judged on regime_timeline_metrics.max_same_quadrant_run_months.
gate_semantics.min_upside_capture_bull_year: In every BULL calendar year (SPY total return > bull_year_spy_return_threshold over a FULL calendar year of common sessions), the strategy must capture at least this fraction of SPY's return. The gate's measured value is the MINIMUM upside_capture across full-coverage bull years in the primary window; partial-coverage years (mid-year window start, truncated benchmark) are surfaced as excluded_partial_years and never enforced; down/flat years are a downside-capture question out of this gate's scope. Judged on upside_capture_by_calendar_year.

rationale: The phase0q_003 stress_gate_semantics_amendment (ratified 2026-07-02) correctly stopped penalizing intended per-window abstention by making consumable_position_coverage the blocking stress metric, but it reclassified fresh_decision_rate / abstention_rate as diagnostics_not_gating and the acceptance envelope stayed risk-only (turnover / MDD / vol / worst-5d / fold stability; no return target). The joint effect: a decision chain that abstained 43 of 66 months (2021-2026) and carried a single 2023-02 contraction book for years reported 100% consumable coverage, near-zero turnover, low vol and low MDD -- i.e. the multi-year defensive carry was the OPTIMUM of the envelope. These gates restore a blocking judgment on the timeline itself: fresh-valid density, abstention streak, carry age, single-quadrant occupancy and benchmark-relative upside in bull years. The bounds are deliberately loose (e.g. 36m fresh-valid >= 0.40, carry age <= 3) rather than tuned to any CAGR/Sharpe target, consistent with the freeze rule to calibrate abstention/flip/duration behaviour and NEVER against CAGR.

amends.effect_when_ratified: IN FORCE since decision_date 2026-07-11: re-elevates fresh_decision_rate and abstention_rate (and, via the timeline gates, carry age and single-quadrant occupancy) from diagnostics_not_gating back to BLOCKING at the run level, surfaced as the 'timeline' entry in gates_overall_base_cost. consumable_position_coverage remains the per-stress-window blocking metric from phase0q_003; these timeline gates are an ADDITIONAL run-level layer, not a repeal of the phase0q_003 carry semantics.
amends.does_not_amend: The frozen model parameters (confidence floor 0.70, axis weights, hysteresis, 10y robust baseline) are NOT touched by this policy. Recalibration is a separate future experiment; this artifact only sets the acceptance bounds it will be judged against.

activation.ratification: SATISFIED: ratified by the quant_owner (Andrei Rachadel) on 2026-07-11, bounds unchanged from the proposal.
activation.in_force: The harness judge (runner.judge_timeline_gates) is GATING for this artifact: every run reports a blocking timeline go/no_go. The frozen v1 model is expected to report no_go until recalibration lands.
activation.carry_decay_v1_runtime: ACTIVE in code (CARRY_DECAY_V1_ACTIVE = True) with the additive schema evolution committed as schemas/open_macro_v03_carry_decay_v1_migration.sql. Remaining OPS steps (not approvals): the orchestrator applies the migration DDL to the production DB in a controlled step, and the worker is redeployed (Railway). Until both land, the worker's verify_schema/publish path fails loud rather than writing old-shaped rows for an expired carry.

governance.note: These pins describe THIS ARTIFACT's own side effects (a policy record writes nothing and activates nothing by itself); runtime activation remains governed by the Stage B activation envelope and its approval matrix. The self-ratification ban stands: this ratification was ordered by the quant_owner and is recorded here, not initiated by the engineering agent.
